summary: Registers a set of IANA Diameter command codes for new vendor-specific Diameter applications defined for the 3GPP Evolved Packet System. Those applications are for network elements such as the mobility management entity and the serving GPRS support node.

plainLanguage.summary: This memo records Diameter command numbers for two 3GPP Evolved Packet System applications. The commands cover subscriber data and mobile equipment identity checks.

subtitle: Command code assignments for 3GPP Evolved Packet System Diameter applications.

tldr.problem: The 3GPP Evolved Packet System applications using Diameter needed command codes for subscriber and equipment identity operations.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC records IANA allocations 316 through 324 for request/answer pairs in the S6a/S6d and S13/S13' applications.
tldr.outcome: The codes identify commands defined by 3GPP TS 29.272; this RFC documents the allocations rather than defining their full behavior.

today: RFC 5516 is an Informational memo registering Diameter command codes for 3GPP EPS applications. The unit metadata lists no update or replacement.

sections.title: The Two Diameter Applications
sections.content:
The 3GPP Evolved Packet System uses Diameter on interfaces between network elements. The S6a/S6d application transfers subscriber-related data between an MME or SGSN and a Home Subscriber Server.

The S13/S13' application supports Mobile Equipment Identity checks between an MME or SGSN and an Equipment Identity Register. The RFC records codes for these vendor-specific applications.
sections.plainLanguage: One application exchanges subscriber data with a home server. Another checks equipment identity with an equipment register.

sections.title: Request and Answer Command Pairs
sections.content:
Codes 316 through 323 cover eight S6a/S6d request-and-answer pairs: update location, cancel location, authentication information, insert subscriber data, delete subscriber data, purge UE, reset, and notify.

Code 324 is assigned to the S13/S13' Mobile Equipment Identity Check request-and-answer pair. Each pair has separate request and answer names but shares its command code value.
sections.plainLanguage: The assigned codes cover subscriber updates, authentication information, notifications, and device identity checks. Each operation has a request and an answer.

sections.title: IANA Allocation and Security
sections.content:
IANA allocated the command code values in the Diameter namespace. The RFC points to 3GPP TS 29.272 for the definitions of these applications and their commands.

The security section says the Diameter Base protocol's security considerations also apply and that no further extensions are required beyond its security mechanisms.
sections.plainLanguage: The memo records IANA's code assignments and points to the 3GPP specification for command details. It relies on the base Diameter security considerations.
